Pax vobis, allelúia: gavísi sunt discípu: 愿你们平安，阿肋路亚：门徒见了主，便喜欢起来，阿肋路亚。
Una ergo sabbatórum, cum fores essent cl: 那一周的第一天，门户都关着，门徒聚集在那里，耶稣来了，站在他们中间，对他们说。
_notes: 15078: Antiphon conflating Jn 20:19 ('Pax vobis') and Jn 20:20 ('gavisi sunt discipuli viso Domino'); rendered using 思高 wording for each half with Alleluias in place. 15079: Breviary capitulum excerpting Jn 20:19 — the Latin omits 'vespere' (晚上) and 'propter metum Judaeorum' (因为怕犹太人) present in full 思高 verse; translation follows the Latin scope only, using 思高 wording for the portions covered, ending at 'et dixit eis' (对他们说) before the greeting.
